title: Get Segment
description:
Returns segment information for the provided segment ID.
In addition to the [list API](../list-segments), segment IDs can be extracted from within the Fullstory UI. When on the page for a segment, the URL will contain the segment's ID. For example, the URL `https://app.fullstory.com/ui/ABCD/segments/12345abcdefg/people/0` corresponds to a segment with an ID of `12345abcdefg`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the segment to be retrieved

name.description: The display name of the segment.

creator.description: The email associated with the Fullstory user who created the segment.

created.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp for when the segment was created. Will not be present for built-in segments.

url.description: URL for the corresponding segment in the Fullstory app.
